description: Provision an AWS Apigatewayv2 VPCLink via the ACK apigatewayv2 controller. Fields mirror the apigatewayv2.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 VPCLink spec.

name.description: The name of the VPC link.

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

securityGroupIDs.description: A list of security group IDs for the VPC link.

subnetIDs.description: A list of subnet IDs to include in the VPC link.

title: AWS Apigatewayv2 VPCLink
